resolution: The finite causal power derivation ends at a bearer with intrinsic power in one respect; it establishes no condition about the bearer receiving its very existence from another. The countermodel represents that second question independently through supportsEsse, whose truth is not a power-transmission edge. The original source concept of an external cause of esse is separately defined from that analyst relation. Showing that support of a being's esse would necessarily supply its power in the same respect, or that every composition entails excluded existential dependence, remains a philosophically open bridge (issue #319).
